name: Itsuwari no Reijou Shounen
source:
Liz, a boy living as a noble lady for the sake of a political marriage, harbors an unrequited love for the maid Nymph.On the day before the wedding, he wishes for happiness with Nymph upon the “black rose in which a fairy that grants wishes dwells,” which he has received from his fiancé Crest.

You become the “black rose fairy” and act to grant Liz’s wish, but eventually learn the fact that you were once human.

While exploring the mansion from a first-person perspective, you enter the bodies of various unique characters, view their memories, and search for your own identity.

The fate of the noble boy. The true nature of the fairy. And the hidden truth――.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805930/_/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
为了政治联姻而以贵族小姐的身份生活的少年莉兹，对女仆宁芙怀有单恋。婚礼前一天，他向未婚夫克雷斯特送来的“居住着实现愿望的仙女的黑玫瑰”祈愿与宁芙幸福。

你成为“黑玫瑰仙子”，并采取行动实现莉兹的愿望，但最终却发现你曾经是人类。

在以第一人称视角探索这座宅邸时，你进入各种独特角色的身体，查看他们的记忆，并寻找自己的身份。

贵族少年的命运。仙女的真实本性。还有隐藏的真相——。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805930/_/]Steam[/url]]
